params.name: start_time
params.description: Required. Start time of the listing. REST query parameter is "start_time". Its value will be truncated down to nearest midnight in given time zone and internally converted to UTC after.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Required. End of the listing up to this time, not inclusive. REST query parameter is "end_time". Its value will be rounded up to the nearest midnight in given time zone and internally converted to UTC after.

params.name: agg_interval
params.description:
Required. Aggregate conversation counts in interval buckets over the requested time period. REST query parameter is "agg_interval" with valid values: DAY or WEEK.

 - DAY: Metrics will be aggregated in 24 hour intervals
 - WEEK: Metrics will be aggregated in 168 hour intervals

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Filter conversation counts by collection_id. REST query parameter is "collection_id". The conversation counts must be filtered by either collection or solution.

params.name: solution_id
params.description: Filter conversation counts by solution_id. REST query parameter is "solution_id". The conversation counts must be filtered by either collection or solution. This filter takes precedence over collection_id which it disables.

items.docs: ListConversationCounts retrieves a time-series of the unique conversation counts.
